message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Employment and Working Conditions in the GDR 1985","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13556","justification":"Microdata survey focusing on employment status, occupation, sector, and working conditions in the German Democratic Republic with fieldwork in 1985, directly covering GDR employment during the 1980s."},{"title":"Life in the GDR 1980","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13540","justification":"Representative survey of the GDR population in 1980 that includes modules on employment, occupation, and workplace conditions, relevant to labor in the early 1980s."},{"title":"Life in the GDR 1984","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13542","justification":"Continuation of the GDR population survey series with information on employment situation, occupational status, and work-related attitudes in 1984."},{"title":"Life in the GDR 1988","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13544","justification":"Late‑1980s wave of the GDR survey program containing detailed data on labor force participation, employment biography, and work conditions shortly before 1990."},{"title":"Social Structure and Social Mobility in the GDR 1983","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13562","justification":"Dataset on social structure and mobility in the GDR with central variables on occupational position, employment sector, and career trajectories in 1983."},{"title":"Social Inequality and Social Mobility in the GDR 1986","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13563","justification":"Focuses on inequality and mobility but includes detailed employment information (occupation, industry, employment status) for GDR residents in 1986."},{"title":"GDR Time Budget Survey 1985/86","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13570","justification":"Time‑use survey of GDR households around 1985/86 with variables on employment status, working hours, and division of labor, relevant to labor patterns in the mid‑1980s."},{"title":"GDR Family and Fertility Survey 1988/89","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13575","justification":"Although focused on family and fertility, this dataset includes employment status, occupation, and working hours for men and women in the GDR in 1988/89."},{"title":"GDR Elderly Survey 1985","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13582","justification":"Survey of older persons in the GDR that reconstructs employment histories, retirement transitions, and previous occupations, providing employment-related information for cohorts active during the 1980s."},{"title":"Comparative Survey on Working Conditions in GDR and FRG 1986","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13590","justification":"Comparative dataset explicitly on working conditions, with a GDR sample for 1986, giving detailed information on employment, workplace environment, and job characteristics in the GDR during the 1980s."}]}
